definitions.explanation: The formal act of presenting a gift, award, or certificate to someone. More formal than simply giving.

examples.japanese: {花束|はなたば}を{贈呈|ぞうてい}する。
examples.english: To present a bouquet of flowers.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}で{記念品|きねんひん}が{贈呈|ぞうてい}された。
examples.english: Commemorative gifts were presented at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{功績|こうせき}をたたえて{感謝状|かんしゃじょう}の{贈呈|ぞうてい}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A certificate of appreciation was presented in recognition of many years of meritorious service.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used primarily in ceremonial or official contexts. Common at award ceremonies, graduations, and official events. Used as a suru verb ({贈呈|ぞうてい}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花束|はなたば}を{贈呈|ぞうてい}する (to present a bouquet)
- {賞|しょう}を{贈呈|ぞうてい}する (to present an award)
- {記念品|きねんひん}の{贈呈|ぞうてい} (presentation of a commemorative item)
- {贈呈|ぞうてい}{式|しき} (presentation ceremony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進呈|しんてい}: presenting, offering — also formal, often used for complimentary items
- {授与|じゅよ}: conferral — used for degrees and official awards
